target: target-stock future one-second midpoint log return, basis points

blocks.B: target-stock quote history + report-weighted rest-of-22 quote history and coverage + ES quote history + five-minute time controls
blocks.C: target-stock and report-weighted rest-of-22 separated trade history and coverage; excludes SPY trades

transform.missing_predictors: training-period median plus explicit missing indicator

important_limit: ES contributes quote fields only; no ES trade block was purchased or inferred. Rest-of-22 is the fixed sampled basket, not the complete cash market.
